hints.title: Two Strategies
hints.text: Evaluate cost without reordering versus cost after paying k to reorder elements arbitrarily.

hints.title: Sorted Pair Alignment
hints.text: If rearrangement cost k is paid, pairing sorted elements minimizes absolute sum of deviations.

hints.title: Direct Comparison
hints.text: Compute element-wise differences directly, compare against k plus sorted pairwise differences, and take the minimum.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: n: length of arrays arr and brr
complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n) followed by linear difference summations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching over all permutation orders takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary space stores sorted copies.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that any reordering costs at most k and sorting optimally minimizes L1 differences.
